_comment: CYBERDUDEBIVASH(R) SENTINEL APEX -- MISP Feed descriptor. Add via MISP's Administration > Feeds > Add Feed, or import this file directly (Feeds > Import feed metadata from URL/file). Points at the REAL, live, Enterprise-gated GET /api/misp/export endpoint (workers/intel-gateway/src/enterprise-endpoints.js, handleMISPExport) -- a genuine MISP 2.4 Event/Attribute/Tag JSON export built from the platform's live feed, not a fabricated placeholder. Requires a Sentinel APEX ENTERPRISE (or MSSP) API key; PRO/FREE keys receive a 403.

Feed.name: CYBERDUDEBIVASH SENTINEL APEX
Feed._headers_comment: MISP >=2.4.130 supports custom per-feed HTTP headers via this field (tested against modern MISP releases at the time this was written; older installs without header support should instead run the response through a reverse proxy that injects the X-API-Key header). Never commit a real key into this file -- replace the placeholder locally after import.

_pagination_note: handleMISPExport supports since/report_id/limit query params (see /api-docs.html#misp-export) -- MISP's own feed puller re-fetches the full URL on each cache-refresh interval, so this descriptor deliberately omits `since` and relies on delta_merge:true for incremental updates within MISP itself.
_alternative_taxii_note: For organizations preferring TAXII 2.1 pull over MISP's native feed format, see integrations/opencti/ for the same Enterprise-gated data via the platform's real /taxii/ server (collections: sentinel-apex-main, sentinel-apex-kev, c2-indicators, active-ransomware, apt-attribution).
